Super food awful smoke but still go!
Mar 2021 • Family
If this was based on the ambience, decor , smoke and service it would be a 2 but on the food and value for money it’s a 4 - we had a Sunday Lamb roast. My expectations were not high due to all the above - but both my wife and I were taken aback by the size of the portion , the quality and taste of the lamb, perfectly cooked with roast and sweet potato, onion, peas etc . I didn’t think I could eat it all but polished off the lot ! Unfortunately they had no desert available as I would have tried another dish... 
so based on the food - it was great -
Also value for money excellent .. in fact I could not believe how inexpensive this could be .. the Saigon Red was 15000 VND and the total bill came to less than 350000 VND - incredible!!!!!
On value for money and food alone you must go there - i only wish that it was non smoking as my baby was getting choked so we had to run out straight after the food .

No frills and all muscles! With vegetarian options!
Sep 2020 • Family
The food is so fresh and yumm. They have clean plates, right tools like knives and forks, supply of right condiments. Service is fast and the hostess is very pleasant. There are vegetarian options. Hot coffee is available- where they care to provide you sugar and milk seperately! Their pancakes are the most amazing ones I have ever had. The mango shake was outstanding too. Portion size is good. The place is an absolute gem, don't go by the appearance of the shop, their courtesy and food is more amazing than most high end restaurants offer. Do not miss this place!!

Popular with the ex pats
Feb 2020 • Friends
There's nothing terribly subtle about this Western restaurant - with the odd Asian dish - which has an understandably strong and loyal ex pat customer base! 

Good, uncomplicated food which should fill your stomach nicely with the added bonus of a pretty decent Sunday roast sans Yorkshire Pudding which is unfortunate! 

The portion sizes are on the generous side and the service is always friendly and efficient.

The prices are slightly better - as in cheaper - than most of their competitors and they also provide a delivery service.

The restaurant doesn't have air conditioners but they have plenty of wall fans to keep you cool.
